title: Encoding a directed path instance
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $A$ be a Boolean matrix indexed by pairs of vertices in $ brange{0,n}$, and let $s,t$ be vertices among these $n$ vertices. Encode the data by pairing the length-$n$ list consisting entirely of true values with a pairing of the row-by-row list of entries of $A$ and a pairing of the binary expansions of $s$ and $t$.
